facts.statement: A different community event was held every Thursday, such as a beach party or Demolition Derby.
facts.quote: Nous avons un événement différent tous les jeudis.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New? (Foire d'échange, Visites de Maisons et Fête de Pirate)
article_summaries.summary: A French-language community recap of Free Realms weekly in-game events: a trade fair at Criqueville, weekly Tuesday house tours starting at the Sanctuary, and Thursday events such as beach parties or Demolition Derby. It also covers a pirate party at Criqueville docks celebrating the release of the Pirate's Plunder mini-game, and explains how to find the event calendar in the Game Guide.
